aiSummary.title: AI Summary
aiSummary.description: 2-sentence summary: 'Visit at [hospital] with [doctor]. [Drug] discussed, outcome [X], next step [Y].' Write in plain English even if rep spoke Hinglish.

engagementScore.title: Engagement Score (0-100)
engagementScore.description: Infer from sentiment. Very enthusiastic/committed = 85-95. Positive but standard = 65-80. Neutral/sochenge = 45-55. Not interested = 20-40. Hostile/refused = 5-15.

hospitalName.title: Hospital or Facility Name
hospitalName.description: Hospital name (e.g. 'Apollo Mumbai', 'Tata Memorial', 'HCG Bangalore'). Improves physician lookup accuracy.

physicianName.title: Physician Name
physicianName.description: Doctor's name as spoken (e.g. 'Dr. Sharma', 'Iyer sir', 'Sharma madam'). Strip honorifics to resolve but store full name.

transcript.title: Voice Transcript
transcript.description: Full statement from the rep. Include drugs discussed, outcome, follow-ups, anything they mentioned. This is the source of truth.

visitOutcome.title: Visit Outcome
visitOutcome.description: Exactly one of: Positive, Negative, Neutral, Follow-Up Required. Infer from rep's words. 'positive raha / accha gaya / bahut accha / interested' = Positive. 'dobara jaana hai / follow-up chahiye' = Follow-Up Required. No strong signal = Neutral.

visitType.title: Visit Type
visitType.description: Exactly one of: In-Person Clinic, Hospital Round, Virtual Call, Conference / Event, Drop-In. 'chamber mein gaya' = In-Person Clinic. 'hospital mein round' = Hospital Round. Default = In-Person Clinic.
